name: list_buckets
description: Lists the buckets of a project.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of buckets to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 1000 buckets will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListBuckets` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to `ListBuckets` must match the call that provided the page token (except `page_size`, which may differ).

prefix.description: Optional. Filter results to buckets whose names begin with this prefix.
